location.name: Place name (optional)

interactive.urlHelp: A secure link starting with https

policy.title: General policy
policy.hint: Sets who sees conversations, when they close and when they are deleted.
policy.visibilityDescription: Anyone with the assign permission always sees every conversation.

visibilityHint.assigned_only: A staff member sees only the conversations assigned to them.
visibilityHint.department: A staff member sees their own conversations, their department's, and unassigned ones that have no department.
visibilityHint.all: Everyone with the read permission sees every conversation.

policy.retentionHint: Conversations older than this are deleted with their attachments.
policy.assignmentDescription: Applied after the rules to a conversation that has no assignee, among its department members or all agents when it has no department.

assignmentHint.manual: Nothing is assigned automatically; staff pick what they handle.
assignmentHint.round_robin: New conversations go to the members in turn.
assignmentHint.least_open: New conversations go to the member with the fewest open conversations.

policy.firstResponseHint: The assignee is notified when a customer has waited this long without a reply. 0 turns the alert off.

presets.title: Sector presets
presets.hint: Set several options at once: departments, tags, canned replies and the visibility policy.
presets.confirmDescription: Only missing items are added and nothing is deleted, but the visibility policy and retention change if the preset sets them.

clinic.name: Clinic
clinic.description: Reception and appointments departments, tags such as booking and cancellation, and canned replies for appointments.

store.name: Store
store.description: Sales and support departments, tags such as order and complaint, and canned replies for orders.

public_service.name: Public service
public_service.description: Assignee-only visibility, longer retention, and canned replies for transactions.

departments.title: Departments
departments.hint: Departments route conversations to the people who answer them.
departments.membersHint: Staff who see this department's conversations and reply to them.
departments.deleteDescription: Its conversations stay but lose their department.

tags.title: Tags
tags.hint: Staff classify conversations with these tags.
tags.deleteDescription: The tag is removed from every conversation.

canned.title: Canned replies
canned.hint: Staff type / and the start of a shortcut in the reply box to get the canned reply suggested.
canned.deleteDescription: Messages already sent are not affected.

channels.title: Channels
channels.hint: The WhatsApp numbers connected to the inbox.
channels.connectHint: Connect a WhatsApp Business number through the Cloud API.
channels.departmentHint: Conversations of this channel reach this department.
channels.phoneNumberIdHint: The Phone number ID from your Meta app dashboard.
channels.appSecretHint: Used to verify that incoming messages really come from Meta.

form.accountHint: Find them in your Meta developer app dashboard.
form.secretsHint: They are stored encrypted and are never shown again.

webhook.title: Webhook setup
webhook.hint: Paste the URL and the token into the webhook settings of your WhatsApp app in Meta, then subscribe to the messages event.

channels.secretsHint: Leave a field empty to keep the stored value.
channels.disableHint: The channel stops receiving and sending messages until it is enabled again.
channels.enableHint: The channel is disabled. Enable it to resume receiving and sending.
channels.deleteHint: Deletes the channel with all its conversations and messages.
channels.deleteDescription: This cannot be undone. The conversations and messages of the channel are deleted.
channels.appIdHint: Optional. Needed only to upload the sample file of a template header with an image, video or document.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.hint: WhatsApp templates that Meta reviews before they can be used to reply after the 24-hour window closes.
templates.createHint: The template is sent to Meta for review when saved and cannot be used until it is approved.
templates.empty: This channel has no templates. Create one or sync the templates from Meta.
templates.saved: Template saved and sent to Meta
templates.serverError: Meta refused the template or it could not be saved
templates.readonlyDescription: Meta accepts no edit in the template's current status, or you cannot manage templates.
templates.deleteHint: The template is deleted from Meta and from WebVue and can no longer be used.
templates.deleteDescription: Queued messages that use this template will fail.

categoryHint.marketing: Offers, news and campaigns. Meta charges more for them.
categoryHint.utility: Messages about an order, appointment or existing service.
categoryHint.authentication: A one-time verification code. Meta sets the template text.

form.identityHint: The name and language cannot change after the template is created.
form.name: Template name
form.nameHint: Lowercase English letters, digits and underscores only.
form.allowCategoryChangeHint: If Meta judges another category fits better it moves the template there instead of rejecting it.
form.headerHint: Optional. Shown above the message text.
form.sampleHint: Meta reviews a sample of the file. The Meta app id must be set in the channel settings.
form.locationHint: The location is sent with every message that uses this template.
form.bodyHint: Press add variable to insert the next value, and give an example for each variable.
form.examplesHint: Meta asks for a realistic example of each variable to review the template.
form.footerHint: Optional. A small line under the text.

invalid.name: Use lowercase English letters, digits and underscores
invalid.body: The text is required, up to 1024 characters, with consecutive variables
invalid.body_examples: Give an example for every variable
invalid.footer: The footer is at most 60 characters
invalid.buttons: Check the buttons and their limits
invalid.otp_button_text: Button text is required, up to 25 characters

button.limits: Limits: 10 buttons, two links, one call button, one copy-code button. Quick replies sit together, before or after the other buttons.

problem.grouping: Quick replies must be next to each other

button.copyCodeHint: The customer copies the code you type when sending.
button.urlExampleHint: The link with the variable replaced by a real value.

auth.title: Authentication options
auth.hint: Meta sets the text of an authentication message. Choose only what surrounds it.
auth.securityRecommendationHint: Adds a notice not to share the code with anyone.
auth.expirationHint: Optional. From 1 to {max} minutes, shown in the message footer.
auth.previewSecurity: For your security, do not share this code.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: This is how the customer sees it. The text direction follows the template language.

templates.unsupportedDescription: This template uses parts WebVue cannot fill (such as named variables or flow buttons), so it cannot be edited or sent from here. Manage it in Meta's dashboard.

automation.contentRequired: Write the message text or complete the interactive message.
automation.invalid: Check the fields: an enabled message needs valid content and every option label is required.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.hint: Decide when the away message is sent and when a rule's hours condition applies. With no range at all the inbox is always open.
hours.alwaysOpen: No range is set, so the inbox is always open.
hours.overlap: The ranges overlap on this day.
hours.holidaysHint: On a holiday the inbox counts as outside working hours.
hours.ownHoursOn: The department follows the hours below instead of the company's.
hours.ownHoursOff: The department follows the company working hours.

welcome.title: Welcome message
welcome.hint: Sent on a customer's first message of a new conversation. Outside working hours the away message is sent instead.

away.title: Away message
away.hint: Sent when a customer writes outside working hours or on a holiday.
away.repeatHoursHint: At most one message per conversation in this period.

csat.title: Satisfaction survey
csat.hint: After an agent resolves the conversation the customer gets a question with three buttons, and the choice is saved on the conversation.
csat.question: Question text

messages.title: Automatic messages
messages.hint: The welcome, away message and satisfaction survey of each channel.

rules.title: Auto-reply rules
rules.hint: Rules are tried in order and the search ends at the first matching rule with "stop".
rules.createHint: When the rule applies and what it does.
rules.keywordsHint: Press Enter after each word or phrase. Case, diacritics and letter forms do not matter.
rules.optionIdHint: The id of the button or row the customer chose, such as btn_1 or row_2.
rules.stopHint: Later rules are not tried when this one matches.
rules.deleteDescription: It stops applying to new messages; messages already sent are not affected.

test.title: Try it
test.hint: Type a sample customer message to see what the automation would do. Nothing is sent.

kpi.freeHint: Service window and free entry points

tiles.limitHint: Per 24 hours, shared by all numbers of the business portfolio

nameReasons.NAME_EMPLOYEE_ISSUE: The name belongs to an employee

nameReasons.NAME_INDIVIDUAL_ISSUE: The name belongs to an individual

webhook.description: Subscribe to these fields in the Meta app so every change to the number, account and templates reaches us.

register.hint: Register again after changing the PIN or migrating the number. It needs the two-step PIN (6 digits).
register.confirmDescription: Meta allows only ten registration attempts per number in 72 hours, then blocks the number for 72 hours. Check the PIN before you continue.

insights.title: Template analytics
insights.hint: A one-time opt-in on the business account gives us delivery, read and click figures.
insights.confirmDescription: This cannot be undone: Meta does not allow turning analytics off once it is on. It is unavailable for EU, UK and Japan accounts.

sync.hint: Pull cost and template analytics from Meta now. Once every 10 minutes per channel.
